description: Read a room's append-only log of successful ops, oldest first, up to 500 rows: one line per row, seq agent type entity result (create, edit, remove, fork, propose, accept, reject...). Propose rows carry the p_ proposal id that world_accept and world_reject take. Filter with entity (one entity id) and after (to read only newer rows). Read-only, no token. Optional room (default: your current room). For the current state, use world_look.
name: world_history
